newsitem.title: FRANCE: BMW Roadster wins women's hearts at Paris car show.
newsitem.headline: BMW Roadster wins women's hearts at Paris car show.

text.p: BMW's Roadster Z3 emerged as the top choice of 5,000 women gathered at the Paris car show to vote on 10 new or revamped models.

A Peugeot 106 whose interior was designed by model Ines de la Fressange and a Volkswagen Polo 100 came in second and third place, followed by the Citroen Berlingo and the restyled Renault Twingo, the organisers of the women's event Interdeco said in a statement.
The other cars in the running were the new Ford Ka minicar, the Hyundai coupe, Fiat's Lancia Y, Nissan's Micra Plaza and the Opel Tigra.

A survey conducted by polling agency Sofres of 550 women at the event found that the biggest proportion, 37 percent, said their dream car would be a sportscar, followed by 34 percent who prefer small easy-to-park models.
The survey found that 58 percent of women preferred to drive than be driven. It said designer car furnishings and sunvisors with mirrors are among the most popular features with women.
